title: Unblock the release path
description: pnpm release always fails: CHANGELOG.md is a single heading and no changeset has ever been consumed, so scripts/release.mjs refuses with no CHANGELOG section for version 0.1.0 (exit 1, proven by tests/guards/release.test.ts). Consume a changeset or write the first 0.1.0 section so the refusal path is no longer the only reachable path. The remaining tag and gh release paths still need tests with a scratch remote and a stub gh on PATH.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text:
**What changed.** The release path is unblocked via the changeset flow, proving the whole pipeline rather than just the file: wrote `.changeset/great-pandas-shake.md` (patch), ran `pnpm changeset version` (consumed it, wrote `## 0.1.1` with the scaffold notes, bumped package.json 0.1.0 to 0.1.1). `node scripts/release.mjs --print-notes` now exits 0 with the notes. Added the invariant test "the real checkout's own version has non-empty notes": it runs `--print-notes` with the default version against the real repo, so any future commit that removes or empties the section fails the build instead of failing at release time.

**Red to green proof, both directions.** Before: `--print-notes` exited 1 with "no CHANGELOG section for version 0.1.0". After: exit 0. And the new test was proven to bite by stashing CHANGELOG.md + package.json: 1 failed (the invariant), restored, green again.

**Verification.** pnpm check green: typecheck + lint + 85 tests passing, 21 todo across 17 files (84 to 85). Pre-commit guards clean.

**Known follow-up, out of scope.** `src/index.ts` still hardcodes `extension.version: "0.1.0"` while package.json is now 0.1.1. Untouched deliberately: the entry version is a separate contract and the artifact test pins it. If they must track each other, that is its own ticket.

No changeset needed for this commit itself: the changeset it describes has already been consumed.
comments.author: agent

comments.text: Owner verified in session 2026-10-25: re-ran the full gate green (85 passing), coverage thresholds holding, release path open, no .github present. Closing per explicit owner permission.
comments.author: agent

commits.message: chore(release): first versioned CHANGELOG entry via changesets (0.1.1) with releasability invariant
